atoms.what_it_does: claude_frage launches headless claude -p with JSON output, permission mode and unconditional --disallowedTools Bash. It does not pin --settings, plugin/hook source, or repository root; absent an explicit cwd it executes from Path.home().
atoms.why_it_exists: The Bash-wide deny was added after a demonstrated command-specific/interpreter bypass.
atoms.failure_mode: The exact hook/plugin/effect-enforcement bytes used by voice-delegated claude -p are not bound by this invocation, so repository manifest presence is not runtime hook evidence.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Resumed Claude session identity remains session-scoped and does not create a call-scoped effect identity.
atoms.privacy_implication: Read/Write/Edit and other non-Bash capabilities remain governed by ambient policy whose exact installed identity is unobserved here.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Caller permits a long delegated timeout; no provider execution was attempted in this source-only run.
atoms.state_lifetime: Claude session may persist across voice tasks
known_counterevidence: Donor comments say ~/.claude/settings.local.json applies to headless claude -p, but that is ambient-host policy rather than an invocation-bound settings identity.
open_questions: Which exact settings/plugin/hook bytes load for this installed invocation?
Do all mutating non-Bash tools reach deterministic pre-side-effect authority?

atoms.what_it_does: Declares seven Claude hook events including PreToolUse(*) and Stop, all routing to ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/stern.py hook.
outputs: stern.py hook invocation if plugin is actually loaded
atoms.failure_mode: The manifest can exist in the donor repository without being loaded by the voice-delegated headless process.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Hook timeouts are configured but firing is unobserved here.
known_counterevidence: The preceding exact-current Triggerword-5 Stop crosscheck found synchronous local Ollama inside Stop despite this manifest description saying no LLM in any hook.
open_questions: What exact installed plugin/settings path binds this manifest to the delegated process?

atoms.what_it_does: frank_erinnerung_schreiben directly forwards model-produced subject/value to stern.py gespraech-erinnerung-schreiben with quelle=realtime-tool; it does not pass through the two-stage voice task confirmation gate.
atoms.why_it_exists: Voice is intended to share Frankenstein durable memory rather than remain a disconnected persona.
writes: intended durable memory; exact stern write body not re-audited in this packet
atoms.failure_mode: No examined immutable MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission binds originating call_id, utterance evidence, transformation/epistemic class, generation, privacy/retention and digest.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Realtime call_id is not carried into the helper call.
atoms.privacy_implication: Voice content may be selected for durable storage without a typed retention/privacy admission envelope.
known_counterevidence: Persona/tool text instructs selective important-memory use, but behavioral instruction is not deterministic admission enforcement.
open_questions: Which stern-side canonical write rules should survive behind MemoryAdmission?

atoms.what_it_does: frank_forschung is described as explicit-user-request-only, but aktion=neu_anstossen mechanically needs only a nonempty question before background dispatch; _forschung_taetigkeit then calls stern chatgpt-senden. No equivalent two-step HumanIntent gate is source-visible in this path.
outputs: cached read or new asynchronous research request
atoms.failure_mode: Explicit-user-request restriction is model-facing policy rather than deterministic HumanIntent/Capability/Privacy/Economic admission.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Background auftrag_id does not preserve the originating Realtime call_id.
atoms.privacy_implication: Research text can enter downstream automation; exact egress is unobserved here.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Potentially long downstream work; current Clay FREE_ONLY authority kept provider execution disabled in this run.
atoms.state_lifetime: background task plus downstream research state
known_counterevidence: The persona/tool description strongly says explicit request only; model compliance is not an enforcement receipt.
open_questions: What downstream provider/economic gate is actually installed for chatgpt_senden?
How should ResearchRequestCandidate bind exact HumanIntent evidence and current FREE_ONLY authority?

hypotheses: A source-bound TaskAdmission/WorkExecutionBinding should carry Realtime call identity through delegated Claude work while pinning the exact settings/plugin/hook identity used for enforcement.
Memory and research require distinct typed admissions rather than blindly reusing the external-task confirmation state machine.
counterhypotheses: Ambient Claude user settings or an installed Frankenstein plugin may already fire the intended final hooks. Even if true, the examined invocation does not bind those bytes, so reproducibility/runtime credit remains open.
Model-facing tool descriptions may be reliable enough in ordinary use, but this does not satisfy deterministic fail-closed state/effect authority requirements.
contradictions: Repository plugin config declares PreToolUse(*) and Stop hooks, but claude_frage does not source-bind a plugin/settings identity or repo cwd.
Voice tasks have a mechanical two-stage confirmation gate while memory-write and new-research tool paths do not use an equivalent typed admission.
Hook config/plugin metadata state no LLM call inside hooks while the preceding current-donor Stop crosscheck found synchronous local Ollama.
critical_unknowns: Exact installed Claude settings/plugin bytes and hook firing for headless voice delegation.
Whether non-Bash mutations traverse deterministic pre-side-effect final authority on the actual host.
Exact downstream provider/egress/economic behavior of chatgpt_senden; no provider execution was attempted.
Runtime preservation of Realtime call identity into downstream work/effect receipts.

recommended_next_spans.reason: Recover exact documented Claude plugin/settings installation/launch path and separate install spec from runtime load evidence.
Trace memory-write and chatgpt_senden to the actual canonical-state/effect/provider boundaries.
Locate existing headless claude -p hook-firing/effect-boundary tests before creating any duplicate lane.
